newsitem.title: CHINA: China declares national holiday to mark HK handover.
newsitem.headline: China declares national holiday to mark HK handover.

text.p: China on Wednesday declared a national holiday on July 1 to enable its 1.2 billion people to celebrate Beijing's resumption of sovereignty over Hong Kong on that day.
"Our government will resume the exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong from July 1 and this is a great event in China's history," the Xinhua news agency said.
"To enable the broad masses of the people to celebrate the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in different ways, it has been decided that July 1 will be a national holiday," it said.
China is planning hundreds of celebrations nationwide to mark the resumption of sovereignty over Hong Kong after more than 150 years of British colonial rule.
Hong Kong has declared a five-day holiday for the handover from June 28 to July 2.
